title: Q2 service work-order KPI calculation
prompt:
Calculate the company-level Q2 service KPIs for April 1 through June 30.

Begin with the service-operations request in `Requests/`. Locate the dispatch/KPI workpapers, the service-pricing and callback notes, the employee roster, and the most recent operating-review materials. Reconcile the retained work-order population to completed work orders from the contractor-accounting MCP. Apply the documented first-time-fix and operating-value definitions; do not substitute invoiced GAAP revenue for the operating proxy.

Report completed work orders, callbacks, first-time-fix rate, billable hours, total labor-plus-material proxy, and average proxy value per completed work order. Do not edit files.

Return only one JSON object in your final response with exactly these keys: `completed_work_orders`, `callbacks`, `first_time_fix_rate`, `billable_hours`, `revenue_proxy`, `average_revenue_per_work_order`. Use dollar values to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals (for example, return 0.1863 for 18.63%), and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
